process.title: Tell us about the garden
process.text: Send photos, rough sizes and what you would like: patio only, or paths and lawn too.

process.title: Visit and layout
process.text: We check levels, drainage and access, and agree the layout and porcelain with you.

process.title: Detailed written quotation
process.text: You receive a written quotation for the patio and any other garden work.

process.title: Build
process.text: Our crew prepares the sub-base, sets the falls and drainage, and lays the porcelain.

faqs.q: Why does the sub-base matter so much?
faqs.a: Porcelain is only as good as what it sits on. A properly compacted sub-base keeps the paving level and stops it moving or cracking.

faqs.q: Will water sit on the patio?
faqs.a: It should not. We lay the patio with falls and plan the drainage so rainwater runs off.

faqs.q: Can you do the lawn, paths and garden store as well?
faqs.a: Yes. We rebuild whole gardens, including drainage, paving, lawn, lighting and garden stores.
The area, the porcelain you choose, access to the garden, steps and level changes, and how much drainage is needed. Your detailed written quotation sets it out.

faqs.q: Do you work in my area?
faqs.a: We work within 50 km of Dunshaughlin, Co. Meath. That covers all of Dublin and towns in Meath, Kildare, Louth (such as Drogheda) and north Wicklow.
